## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2024-12-20: First form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 to S-1/A Amendment No. 1
- 2025-01-07: Revised form-of TRA filed with S-1/A Amendment No. 3; adds Section 2.1 "Basis Adjustments; 754 Election"
- 2025-01-17: Master Reorganization closes and TRA is executed; preamble dated January 17, 2025
- 2025-01-21: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to 8-K

#### Beneficiary-reshaping events (no TRA text change)

- 2025-03-17: Omnibus Agreement corrects Class B Common Stock and Common Unit allocations to the Continuing Equity Owners; reshapes per-beneficiary economic interest in future payments but does not modify the TRA contract
- 2026-03-19: Secondary offering by selling stockholders; concurrent LLC Interest redemption activity drives Q1 2026 TRA liability jump from $21.95M to $92.44M

## Explanation

Flowco Holdings Inc. went public on January 17, 2025 in an Up-C IPO and committed to pay the Continuing Equity Owners and certain Blocker Shareholders (collectively the "TRA Participants") 85% of cash tax savings from basis adjustments arising from the Reorganization-related blocker mergers and from future redemptions or exchanges of LLC Interests, Section 704(c) allocations on PubCo's acquisition of LLC Interests, imputed interest on TRA payments, and certain Reorganization-related distributions or deemed distributions. The contract is in force with no amendments. A March 2025 Omnibus Agreement corrected Class B and Common Unit allocations to the Continuing Equity Owners (reshaping the per-beneficiary share of future payments) without modifying the TRA itself. Exchange activity around the March 2026 secondary offering drove a substantial increase in the recognized TRA liability from $21.95M at year-end 2025 to $92.44M at March 31, 2026; this is contractual operation of the TRA, not an amendment. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
